title: Fix AI script generator navigation from trending topics

requirements.summary: Update TrendingTopicCard to serialize and pass complete trending topic data when navigating to VideoConfigurationPage
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the 'Create Video' button on any trending topic card successfully navigates to VideoConfigurationPage
The VideoConfigurationPage receives and displays the topic title without showing 'Topic not found' error
All topic data (hashtags, keywords, platform, metrics) is accessible in VideoConfigurationPage for script generation

file_operations.description: Update the 'Create Video' button click handler to serialize the complete TrendingTopic object (id, topic, hashtags, keywords, platform, metrics) as URL parameters using the urlParams utility or pass as navigation state. Ensure all topic properties are properly encoded and preserved during navigation to VideoConfigurationPage. The navigation should use the router's navigate function with the topic data embedded in a way that VideoConfigurationPage can extract.

requirements.summary: Update VideoConfigurationPage to correctly extract and display trending topic data from URL parameters or navigation state
acceptanceCriteria: VideoConfigurationPage successfully extracts topic data from URL parameters or navigation state
Topic title is displayed prominently on the VideoConfigurationPage
Script generation form is accessible and functional with the topic context
No 'Topic not found' errors appear when navigating from trending topics

file_operations.description: Update the component to extract trending topic data from URL parameters using the urlParams utility functions (getUrlParam, getHashParam) or from navigation state. Parse the topic object containing id, topic, hashtags, keywords, platform, and metrics. Display the topic title prominently in the page header or form. Update the initial state or context to use the extracted topic data. Remove or fix the 'Topic not found' error condition by ensuring proper data extraction. Ensure the topic data is available for script generation and video project creation.

Add utility functions to serialize and deserialize complex objects (TrendingTopic) for URL parameter passing. Implement functions like setTopicParams(topic: TrendingTopic) and getTopicParams(): TrendingTopic | null that handle encoding/decoding of nested objects including arrays (hashtags, keywords) and metrics object. Maintain compatibility with existing hash-based routing and sessionStorage persistence.

requirements.summary: Ensure the 'Generate Script' functionality is properly triggered and displays generated content in an editable textarea
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Generate Script' button is visible and clickable on VideoConfigurationPage
Clicking 'Generate Script' triggers the script generation mutation without errors
Generated script content appears in an editable textarea after generation completes
Loading states are displayed during script generation
Error messages are shown if script generation fails

file_operations.description: Verify and fix the 'Generate Script' button wiring to ensure it calls the useScriptGeneration mutation hook with proper parameters (topic, language, duration, style). Ensure the mutation result (script object with hookLine, mainContent, duration, language, style) is stored in component state and displayed in an editable textarea. Add proper loading state UI that shows during mutation.isLoading. Add error handling that displays mutation.error messages to the user. Ensure the textarea is visible and editable after successful script generation. Wire the generated script data to the video project creation flow.
